title: Concrete Pump for Basement and Underground Placement
seoTitle: Concrete Pump for Basement Underground | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Alibaba buying guides mention mini pumps for basement and indoor pours. Pinjin Electric 15 is 450 kg, 1900×900×1200 mm; B500S is 280 kg. Catalogue vertical metres are not a basement ventilation or confined-space spec. Match the listed row, then inquire.

relatedPaths.label: Mini concrete pump for narrow access

answerBlock.what: Alibaba’s concrete-pump buying guide and mini-pump listings mention basement, indoor and restricted-access pours as a marketplace observation. Pinjin’s compact listed rows: [Electric 15](/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/) 450 kg, 1900×900×1200 mm, 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 60–80 m horizontal / 15–20 m vertical; [B500S](/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/) 280 kg, 5 m / 5 m, 7.5 kW. Those cells are factory dimensions and catalogue distances, not a basement ventilation rate, not a confined-space certificate, and not a diesel-in-cellar recommendation. Electric 15 is 380V 50Hz three-phase. Diesel rows belong outdoors with exhaust — see the diesel no-electricity article.
answerBlock.who: Buyers pouring a basement slab or underground room who can measure door width, lift capacity and whether three-phase power exists on site.
factors: Measure door, corridor and lift against printed L×W×H and weight
Electric 15 needs 380V 50Hz three-phase; B500S-83D is 7.5 kW — not a diesel cellar spec
Catalogue 15–20 m vertical on Electric 15 is a listed distance, not a basement-floor count
Pinjin does not publish a confined-space or underground-ventilation rating

faqs.question: Is Electric 15 a certified confined-space basement pump?
faqs.answer: No such certificate is printed. Electric 15 is 450 kg, 1900×900×1200 mm, 15 kW, 380V 50Hz. Those are catalogue cells. We do not publish a ventilation rate or underground rating. Measure the opening and the lift, then inquire with the slug.

faqs.question: Can I run a diesel trailer pump in a closed basement?
faqs.answer: Pinjin does not publish an indoor-diesel or basement-exhaust spec. Diesel rows are listed with engine power and catalogue distances. Exhaust and air-change rules are site and local-code, not a Xingtai cell. If the site has three-phase power, start from Electric 15 or Electric 20 instead of assuming a diesel cellar setup.

faqs.question: Is B500S enough for a basement slab?
faqs.answer: B500S lists 280 kg, 7.5 kW, 5 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, sand and small stone 5–16 mm (no m³/h cell on this row). That is a fine-stone / mortar-range row, not a coarse-stone basement-slab guarantee. If the mix and distance exceed those cells, look at Electric 15 (8–10 m³/h, 60–80 m / 15–20 m) and send mix photos — we will not invent a cubic-metre basement yield.
